source.title: Kraken's Eye — Monelite 335 ore after BfA patch 8.1.5
source.author: alphageekyvr

quote: prospected 335 monelite ore. To my surprise, that generated 26 Kraken's Eyes!
notes: Firsthand poster explicitly reports 335 Monelite Ore prospected a couple of days after patch 8.1.5 and a 26 Kraken's Eye yield. 335/5=67 five-ore nominal equivalents, not proven completed operation counter; casts=null; do not derive hit count/zero histogram. Patch association stated by player, not an official rate-change confirmation. Independent from Tontons' older BfA ore tallies.
